mapper.select: select main_image from product where product_id=#{product_id}
select count(*) from wishlist where user_id=#{user_id} and product_id=#{product_id}

select c.*, o.toss_orderid, i.price_at_order,i.quantity,i.order_status,i.created_date order_created_date, p.name,p.main_image, d.grade,d.unit_name,d.origin_region, s.store_name from orders_canceled c, orders o, orders_item i, product p, product_detail d, store s where c.user_id=#{user_id} and c.order_item_id=i.order_item_id and i.order_id=o.order_id and c.product_id=p.product_id and c.product_id=d.product_id and p.producer_id=s.producer_id order by order_created_date desc
mapper.delete: delete wishlist where user_id=#{user_id} and product_id=#{product_id}
mapper.select: select rv.*, o.toss_orderid, i.price_at_order,i.quantity, p.name,p.main_image, d.grade,d.unit_name,d.origin_region,d.detail_desc from product_review rv, orders o, orders_item i, product p, product_detail d where writer_user_id=#{user_id} and rv.order_item_id=i.order_item_id and i.order_id=o.order_id and rv.product_id=p.product_id and rv.product_id=d.product_id order by rv.created_date desc

select d.*, o.toss_orderid,o.receiver_name,o.receiver_phone,o.receiver_addr,o.delivery_message, i.price_at_order,i.quantity,i.order_status,i.created_date order_created_date, p.name,p.main_image, pd.grade,pd.unit_name,pd.origin_region,pd.detail_desc, u.userid user_id,u.name user_name from delivery d,orders_item i,product p,product_detail pd,orders o,users u where d.order_item_id=#{order_item_id} and d.order_item_id=i.order_item_id and i.product_id=p.product_id and i.product_id=pd.product_id and i.order_id=o.order_id and o.user_id=u.userid
